head: bf9c45eb
label: CP7_OW12A_FINANCE_CAPTURE_NATIVE6
cause: Installer, not product: composition.install switched to postgres with its own as_role helper, which admits only postgres or cp7_capture as the current role; the harness connects as its admin role, so the install was refused before any case ran. No figure, refusal or screen was exercised.
fix: install and rollback_preuse switch to postgres with the verified installer switch the predecessor stages use (payment.consumer.as_owner, as OW07 and kasbon); the own as_role stays as the guard for the per-function owner switch. The follow-up Native7 run 39835362716 at the same installer was cancelled before it ran, since it would refuse the same way.
